source.why_this_clip: A cast-iron frying pan with its handle to the right sits on a stove, seen from the side and above, with a cook standing behind. Flames rise from the pan and the cook sets a lid on it between 0 and 0.5 s, then the pan sits still under the lid; there are no cuts, and the clip is only 2 s long, so the whole clip is used.
